en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a long neoclassical building with many windows and a central arched entrance, set in front of cultivated fields and low trees. To the right is a church-like structure with a dome and bell tower. Behind, low hills and scattered houses rise up the slope. The caption at the bottom is in French and Greek, and there is a printed web watermark from a Greek archive.
